name: Plotly
project_description: Charts Plotly is a library backend for the contrib Charts module: it registers a 'plotly' chart library plugin so any chart the Charts module can produce (via Views, chart fields, or the Charts render API) can be rendered with the Plotly.js JavaScript charting library. It supports area, bar, boxplot, bubble, candlestick, column, donut, gauge, heatmap, line, pie, radar, scatter and spline chart types, plus Plotly-specific options such as 3D visualization, a dark theme, the interactive modebar, bar mode/gap and line shape/smoothing. Plotly.js (MIT-licensed) is loaded either self-hosted from /libraries/plotly.js or, when enabled in the Charts settings, from the pinned Plotly CDN. A charts_plotly_api_example submodule renders the Charts API demonstration gallery with Plotly.
